ReplayMixEntry.description:
One replay source's contribution to the mix — the per-row-group
provenance record. Counts and locations only; never row text.

source.description: The source as given (a resolved dataset URI keeps its '#sha256=<hash>' pin, so the mix names an exact version).
source.title: Source

rows_taken.description: Rows sampled from this source into the mix.
rows_taken.title: Rows Taken

rows_available.description: Rows this source could have contributed (after the dedup_against_new filter, if enabled).
rows_available.title: Rows Available

ReplayMixEntry.title: ReplayMixEntry

out_path.description: Path the mixed dataset was written to.
out_path.title: Out Path

replay_rows.description: Rows sampled from the replay sources.
replay_rows.title: Replay Rows

ratio_actual.description: replay_rows / total_rows — the ratio actually achieved, which is below `ratio` when the sources ran dry.
ratio_actual.title: Ratio Actual

mix.description: Per-row-group provenance: one entry per source, in `sources` order — the same order their blocks appear in the output.
mix.title: Mix
